claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows two CV axle shafts with rubber boots leaning against the wall.
Photo 0 shows a steering rack assembly among the parts.
Photo 0 shows a radiator or AC condenser with metal fins.
Photo 0 shows a small cylindrical part described only as 'starter-motor-like'; identity not certain from a single distant shot.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows surface grime, oxidation and old grease residue on the parts, not a clean condition.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No scale, receipt, or weighing photo/video shown; cannot confirm total mass from a leaning-parts photo.

risks.risk: Vehicle fitment unknown (make/model/year the parts belong to)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of part numbers, casting marks, or VIN tag on the donor parts
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unidentified scrap/parts, not model-specific

risks.risk: CV axle boot is torn/split, implying possible joint contamination or wear
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the torn boot and the joint underneath
risks.if_unproven: priced as a damaged/compromised axle needing boot and possibly joint replacement

risks.risk: Completeness of assemblies (missing bolts, sensors, hoses, tie rods on steering rack, mounting brackets on radiator)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each connection point/end of every part

risks.risk: Radiator/condenser may leak or have damaged fins
risks.proof: Video of a water/pressure test or clear unobstructed photo of all fin surfaces
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional/leaking, scrap-metal value only

risks.risk: Steering rack could be seized, bent, or have excessive play
risks.proof: Video of the rack shaft being moved manually showing smooth travel without binding
Video of the starter motor spinning when connected to a battery

risks.risk: Actual total weight may differ from claimed 500 kg (common scrap-trade inflation)
risks.proof: Photo/video of all parts together on a visible scale display
risks.if_unproven: priced using a conservative weight estimate from the photo, below the claimed figure

risks.risk: Hidden rust or structural damage on sides not visible in the single photo angle
risks.proof: Additional photos from multiple angles, including undersides

proof_requests: Close-up photos of each part's end connections and any part numbers/casting marks
Photo or video of the parts on a scale showing a numeric weight reading
Video of the steering rack being moved by hand and the starter motor spinning on a battery
Close-up of the torn CV boot and the joint beneath it
Additional angle photos (top, underside) of all parts to check for hidden rust or cracks
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the items as assorted used auto parts in grimy, untested, as-is condition, so a worst-case scrap/parts price can be set while specific proofs could raise it.
